rules_text:
Rules summary In this cooperative game, you play as the assistants of the architect Daedalus. Your goal is to succeed in locking the Minotaur in a labyrinth by completing increasingly difficult Labors . The game has 10 levels originally, additional levels are publishing each season on the official website. Zone of Tiles Levels 3, 4, 7, 9 & 10 Group of Tiles connected to each other and not separated by any walls or the Minotaur (the Tiles must be in one contiguous sequence ). Ariadne & Theseus When you have a Labyrinth card with one of these characters in your hand, you can place it wherever you want without considering the type of Tile on top of your drawing pile!

---

In this cooperative game, help the famous architect Daedalus to lock the Minotaur in an inextricable labyrinth.

Daedalus offers 10 original challenges of progressive difficulty. You will have to create a Labyrinth for the Minotaur by placing cards each your turn on the center of the table. The goal of the game is to fulfill the challenge before you ran out of cards.

Dédale is created in partnership with the festival Alchimie du jeu of Toulouse for the 2024 edition whose theme is mythology. A portion of the profits is donated to the festival for each sale of the game.

—description from the publisher
